Queries.Query: SELECT Id, Title, Description, Status, Priority, UserId, CreatedDate, DueDate, UpdatedDate FROM Tasks;
SELECT Id, Title, Description, Status, Priority, UserId, CreatedDate, UpdatedDate, DueDate FROM Tasks WHERE UserId = @UserId
SELECT Id, Title, Description, Status, Priority, UserId, CreatedDate, UpdatedDate, DueDate FROM Tasks WHERE Id = @Id
UPDATE Tasks SET Title = @Title, Description = @Description, Status = @Status, Priority = @Priority, DueDate = @DueDate WHERE Id = @Id
UPDATE Tasks SET Status = @Status WHERE Id = @Id
